gloss: to resolve; to dissolve; to eliminate

definitions.gloss: to resolve; to eliminate; to clear up (a problem or negative state)
definitions.explanation: To get rid of something undesirable such as stress, misunderstandings, inequalities, or congestion.

definitions.gloss: to dissolve; to cancel; to break off (an agreement or relationship)
definitions.explanation: To formally end a contract, engagement, partnership, or other arrangement.

examples.japanese: ストレスを{解消|かいしょう}する。
{運動|うんどう}で{運動不足|うんどうぶそく}を{解消|かいしょう}した。
examples.english: I resolved my lack of exercise through working out.

examples.japanese: {渋滞|じゅうたい}が{解消|かいしょう}するまで{二時間|にじかん}かかった。
examples.english: It took two hours for the traffic jam to clear up.

examples.japanese: {婚約|こんやく}を{解消|かいしょう}した。
{契約|けいやく}を{解消|かいしょう}する{手続|てつづ}きを{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started the procedure to cancel the contract.

examples.japanese: {両社|りょうしゃ}は{提携|ていけい}{関係|かんけい}を{解消|かいしょう}することで{合意|ごうい}した。
examples.english: Both companies agreed to dissolve their partnership.

notes:
Compound of {解|かい} (untie) + {消|しょう} (extinguish). A very versatile word used for both eliminating problems/negative states and formally ending agreements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ストレス{解消|かいしょう}: stress relief
- {渋滞|じゅうたい}が{解消|かいしょう}する: traffic clears up
- {不安|ふあん}を{解消|かいしょう}する: to relieve anxiety
- {格差|かくさ}を{解消|かいしょう}する: to eliminate disparity
- {婚約|こんやく}を{解消|かいしょう}する: to break off an engagement
- {契約|けいやく}を{解消|かいしょう}する: to cancel a contract

TRANSITIVITY:
Both transitive and intransitive. Problems can {解消|かいしょう}する on their own (intransitive), or someone can actively {解消|かいしょう}する them (transitive).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {解決|かいけつ}する: to solve (a problem — implies finding a solution)
- {解除|かいじょ}する: to cancel, to lift (restrictions, bans, contracts)
- {緩和|かんわ}する: to alleviate, to ease (partial reduction, not full elimination)
